header.name: Zombie Titan BP
header.description: Version 1.7.0 | Zombie, Skeleton, Creeper and Spider Titan and Omegafish bosses (Titans mod), Dark Fists, Obsidian gear, Growth Serum, the Gum Gum Fruit, Doors (the Library, the Seek chase and all of Floor 1, the Hotel), and Players: player-like mobs that play the game to the Ender Dragon, with the Player API item. Made with Claude.
